summary.zh: 菜单第 9 屏的「移动或复制」「设置生效范围」成为真实向导，条目详情与重复组里新增 m / s / d / p：选条目、选目标、预览（计划、blocked、将进入项目目录的提示）、输入 yes（放宽另需键入条目名）、执行、再取 inventory 读回；读回不一致显示「读回失败」与恢复目录，菜单退出码为 1。证据未知的条目与 MCP 条目只给手工命令与可粘贴片段；没有对应 agenthelm dedupe 分组的重复只读展示。
summary.en: The Move or copy and Set the effective scope items of menu screen 9 become real wizards, and the entry detail and duplicate groups gain m / s / d / p: pick an entry, pick a target, preview (plan, blocked, the notice that content enters the project), type yes (widening also needs the entry name), run, then read the inventory back; a mismatch shows read-back failed with the recovery directory and the menu exits with 1. Entries with unknown evidence and MCP entries only get manual commands and paste-ready snippets; duplicates without a matching agenthelm dedupe group are shown read-only.
